question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
-- Final answer: just the state abbreviations
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        lt.state,
        l.gender,
        lt.term_start::DATE as first_term_start,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '0 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_0,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '2 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_2,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '4 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_4,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '6 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_6,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '8 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_8,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL '10 years' + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_10
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.state,
        ft.gender,
        ft.first_term_start,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_0
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_0
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_0,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_2
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_2
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_4
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_4
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_6
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_6
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_6,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_8
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_8
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_8,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_10
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_10
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ret_10
    FROM first_terms ft
    GROUP BY ft.id_bioguide, ft.state, ft.gender, ft.first_term_start
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        COUNT(*) as total_legislators,
        SUM(ret_0) as retained_0,
        SUM(ret_2) as retained_2,
        SUM(ret_4) as retained_4,
        SUM(ret_6) as retained_6,
        SUM(ret_8) as retained_8,
        SUM(ret_10) as retained_10
    FROM retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING SUM(ret_0) > 0 AND SUM(ret_2) > 0 AND SUM(ret_4) > 0 
        AND SUM(ret_6) > 0 AND SUM(ret_8) > 0 AND SUM(ret_10) > 0
),
states_with_both AS (
    SELECT s1.state
    FROM state_gender_retention s1
    JOIN state_gender_retention s2 ON s1.state = s2.state AND s1.gender != s2.gender
    GROUP BY s1.state
)
SELECT DISTINCT sgr.state
FROM state_gender_retention sgr
JOIN states_with_both swb ON sgr.state = swb.state
ORDER BY sgr.state;
